construct: A lysogenic bacteriophage supplies the tox gene. The diphtheria toxin A fragment transfers ADP-ribose from NAD to elongation factor 2, inactivating EF-2 and halting eukaryotic protein synthesis.

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Incomplete immunization, adherent gray bleeding pseudomembrane, cervical lymphadenopathy, and myocarditis identify toxigenic C. diphtheriae.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: Gs/Gi ADP-ribosylation are classic toxin mechanisms and therefore plausible, but correspond to cholera/pertussis; Shiga toxin targets 28S rRNA rather than EF-2.
adversarial_second_pass.expert_reviewer_reversal: Diphtheria toxin directly ADP-ribosylates elongation factor 2, making EF-2 the unique host target.
